notes.title: Announcing Last Card Dungeon!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]it’s me, your solo dev Carlo, dropping in with some exciting news! If you loved my other games, I’m sure you’ll want to check out my latest passion project: [b]Last Card Dungeon[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DZ8dCkUY0iA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]The story...[/h3][p align="start"]Imagine this: you lost a card game in a tavern...and your soul got trapped inside a cursed deck of cards. Now you’re stuck in a dark roguelike dungeon world where every move, every battle eats away your soul, literally your deck of cards. It’s a tough race against time, full of strategy and mystery. You build your deck, explore cursed places, fight for survival, and hunt the hooded figure who trapped you before your cards run out.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]What is it?[/h3][p align="start"]It’s pixel art, roguelike autobattler action with a haunting atmosphere:[/p][list][*][p][b]Autobattler combat:[/b] Your position, combined with your weapon, determines how you'll deal damage to the enemy slots. Choosing the right weapon is the key to survive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gear management:[/b] Equip unique and powerful items that can change your playstyle, but beware! Some cursed gear sticks with you until you find a way to remove it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration & events:[/b] Navigate randomly generated dungeons full of intriguing events, tough choices, and unpredictable encounters that keep every run fresh and exciting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Wishlist it[/h3][p align="start"]Check it out on Steam, wishlist it if you like what you see, and follow for updates. Thanks for all the support so far, it means the world to me![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921690/Last_Card_Dungeon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="start"]Your friend, the solo dev Carlo.[/p]

notes.title: You wanted more!
notes.content:
I’m thrilled to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130170/Full_Metal_Sergeant_2/]Full Metal Sergeant II[/url] is currently in development!

Building on the positive feedback of its predecessor, this sequel promises to enhance your military management experience with improved gameplay mechanics and a brand-new turn-based combat system.

[h3]What’s New in Full Metal Sergeant II?[/h3]

I’ve carefully reviewed [b]every review, comment, and suggestions [/b]from the community in order to make the game more deep but still enjoyable. Full Metal Sergeant 2, is set to take players on a new tactical journey with an improved gameplay, a whole [b]new turn based combat system [/b]and new game mechanics.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/htypjgHt/combat.gif[/img]

Here’s a list of the new features. Stay tuned for more information and gameplay videos

[list]
[*] New turn-based combat system
[*] Revised Skill Tree
[*] Improved pixel art and new animations
[*] Nine specialized uniteds
[*] Hardcore mode (details later)
[/list]

Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130170/Full_Metal_Sergeant_2/]Steam page[/url] for new videos, screenshots and more information about the new game features.

Full Metal Sergeant II is set to launch in late 2025. Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated with the game development.

See you at the bootcamp!
Carlo

notes.title: Recruit Customization and Steam Workshop Integration
notes.content:
Hello everyone, sergeants of Full Metal Sergeant!

I'm really excited to share the latest news about my game! I've been working to bring a touch of customization that I think you'll really enjoy.

[i][DISPLAIMER] This feature is still in beta so please notify me any issue you'll find.[/i]

[b]Recruit Name Customization[/b]
At last, you can customize the names of your recruits, with the new Name Editor I've implemented, you'll be able to rename your soldiers as you see fit. Whether you want to use the names of friends, create a special unit, or simply add a personal touch to your cadets, you can now do it all directly in the game, with the dedicated editor.

[b]Steam Workshop Integration[/b]
And that's not all. I've also integrated Steam Workshop. This means you can now upload your creations and share them with the entire Full Metal Sergeant community. You can also explore and download name sets created by other players. Imagine being able to choose from historical names, movie characters, or something completely original. The possibilities are endless, and I leave it to your imagination to fill the training grounds.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/K8MG2Xpr/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]

[b]How Does It Work?[/b]
Access the Name Editor: In the Options menu, you'll find the Custom Names button to access the Name Editor. From there, you can choose from community created name sets or create new ones.

Upload and Download from Steam Workshop: Once you've created a name set, you can upload it to Steam Workshop with just pressing the 'Save & Upload button'. 

Manage Your Creations: All downloaded name sets will be easily manageable through a button that let you modifiy the name set.

Thank You for Your Support!
This update came to life thanks to your fantastic feedback. I'm excited to see what you'll create and share on Steam Workshop! Keep sending me your ideas and suggestions; they help me improve and make Full Metal Sergeant even more engaging and fun.

Happy training, sergeants!

Best regards,
Carlo, the creator of Full Metal Sergeant

notes.title: Update Platoons
notes.content:
New update rolled out!

[h2]Platoons revamp[/h2]
Bravo, Charlie and Delta platoons were not widely used and so they have been completely revised. Each now offers a unique bonus that adds a layer of strategy to the mission.
[list]
[*] Bravo: Can call a medevac at anytime to end the mission.
[*] Charlie: Add a recruit as a reserve; they join a platoon if a comrade dies or flees.
[*] Delta: A recruit can be promoted to Elite before going to mission (+Damage and always in cover).
[/list]
Those platoons were moved to the second tier of the skill tree. The [b]Head [/b]and [b]Kitchen [/b]locations have been moved down to the first tier.
[i](The purchase of previous platoons has been reset. Prestige will be refunded and the new platoons can be bought again)
[/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/4dSpF2TD/Fu-FRXH8-Xs-AAs-V7b.png[/img]


[h2]New events[/h2]
New events at the gate:
[list]
[*] Family Visit (season 2)
[*] Sharpshooters  (season 3)
[*] Museum curator (season 4)
[/list]
[i](The Official Guide will be updated in the next few days).[/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FsNpw8tS/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h2][BETA] Custom names[/h2]
It's now possible to define custom names for the recruits. In the Options menu you'll find two new buttons, one for exporting the template file and the other for importing it. The template is a simple text file with all the names listed.

[b]Refer to the Official Guide for the complete instructions.[/b]

Rules:
[list]
[*] Max names 73
[*] Max name length: 12 characters
[*] Only supported languages characters are allowed.
[/list]

[i](Please keep in mind this feature is in beta, so report any bug you'll find. ).[/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZqKzBq2R/Full-Metal-Sergent-12.png[/img]



[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a second leaderboard to keep track of missions accomplished.
[*]Added a text explaining that the ungraduated recruits won't be deployed to the mission.
[*]Added a text telling if no MOD has been assigned to a recruit.
[*]Journalist event: Added Prestige if you choose not to give the interview.
[*]Fixed a bug in which the game would crash in the Options menu if played offline.
[/list]

notes.title: Lack of supplies? We can continue anyway!
notes.content:
[h2]Zero Supplies[/h2]
A lack of supplies no longer ends a mission in failure. Now the platoon can continue on, though with a heavy penalty to soldier stats. This should leave more flexibility during a mission.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/gkxkbqJH/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h2]New training - Rifle Drill[/h2]
Added new training; Rifle Drill will raise a recruit's Shooting at a PT zone. The Shooting Range does it better, but Rifle Drill area is available at the start.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/x1xZ0b1G/Full-Metal-Sergent-1.png[/img]


[h2]Ground audios[/h2]
Terrain-based sound has been introduced. For example, when the platoon moves into a lake tile there is now a big 'Splash' sound.


[h2]Other stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Soldiers on missions earn more XP from non-combat events.
[*] Two initial cadences are now available at the beginning of the game.
[/list]

See you in the next update!
Carlo.

notes.title: Demo Updated!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo version 0.310[/h2]

The demo launch provided great feedback! A number of things have been revised to improve the game.

[h3]Skill tree[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fyddQ8r9/skill-tree.png[/img]
The skill tree's passive skills have been moved to a common section. So even if you choose to specialize in one branch, there is a possibility to acquire passive skills such as 'Insult mode' (not available in demo).


[h3]Map sectors[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J7HZXhzz/map-sector.png[/img]
When you leave the mission the current sector is now displayed to make things more clear.


[h3]Better info[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/X7MFk0rc/tutorial.png[/img]
After watching some videos of streamers, I noticed that some users were having a difficult to understand that you can click on the 'Barracks' for more information. There is now a smart tutorial that shows an animated arrow only if the 'Barracks' menu hasn't been opened by the 2nd week.


[h3]Discpline[/h3]
Based on your feedback, the 'Discipline' check during the mission now happens less frequently; soldiers will flee less often.


Thanks to everybody for playing my game! See you on the next news post...
Carlo.

notes.title: Not only trainings!
notes.content:
Full Metal Sergeant is not just about training and fighting. You will also be competing against other camps in various events.

We had already talked about competitions right? Let's see a little more.

[h2]Running[/h2]
Strength and agility determine how well your recruits perform at competitions. Recruits with the fat trait will face an additional struggle.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Y9XBbRFv/running.gif[/img]

[h2]Shooting[/h2]
Shooting is, of course, vital. But recruits must also cultivate intelligence if they want to be a sniper.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wv99W3bG/shooting.gif[/img]

[h2]Swimming[/h2]
Agility and strength are also necessary for swimming, and you'll need plenty of training in the pool because the navy schools are very demanding.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vmsyBcMZ/swimming.gif[/img]

notes.title: Enemy spotted!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Today I will show a portion of a mission that your recruits might face after graduating.
The map is revealed as Alpha Team advances. Popups indicate the presence of encounters.

[i][h3]"Spotted!"[/h3][/i]
Alpha Team has just made contact with an enemy infantry group. The red color indicates it is quite dangerous. Is it better to go around them?

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wTc8gFhg/mission.gif[/img]


[i][h3]"We found a cache!"[/h3][/i]
Each time your teams move on the map, they expend supplies. Eventually their supplies will run out and they will have to call for an early extraction. Fortunately, there are events where they can locate valuable crates.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/VvXySWp9/supplies.png[/img]


[i][h3]"We need snipers."[/h3][/i]
There will be some encounters where heavy firepower alone might not suffice. Have you trained your recruits to be agile? If so then they might be able to sneak into the enemy camp. Are your men skilled in shooting? Sometimes one sniper shot can do what brute force can't.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/PxgsrR3r/prison.png[/img]

...In the next post we'll go into more detail about the combat system.

See you soon!
Carlo.

notes.title: Upgrade the boot camp!
notes.content:
Hello!

Today's devblog focuses on the system for upgrading your military camp. The game has a skill tree (well it's more correct to say an upgrade tree) where you can buy equipment, training and services using the Prestige Points of your camp.

[h2]Equipments[/h2]
The main thing to buy is zone equipments, each one provides a basic default training right away. The upgrade path will also decide how recruits will develop, whether more on the sniper shooting or experienced amphibious troops.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DfBFWgq6/skill-tree.gif[/img]


[h2]Training[/h2]
Each equipment gives access to other trainings, that raise one or more of the recruit's skills but also affect stamina and stress. They can be ugraded, giving much more skill value at the same cost.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HL2vSSWP/skill-upgrade.gif[/img]


[h2]Services[/h2]
There are also services such as the Guardhouse. Unlocking it and assign a recruit; he won't participate in training session but will be able to recover stamina and stress.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cL6h5H8f/skill-service.gif[/img]


...there's also other things in the upgrade tree, but I will focus on them next time...

See you in the next devBlog!
Carlo.

notes.title: Compete against other camps!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! 

Second devblog here; this time it's all about the competition system.
In Full Metal Sergeant you will not only have to build great soldiers, but you will also have to show their skills during competitions against other camps. 

Every 2 weeks there will be new competitions available at the bulletin board. Actually there are three types: 
[list]
[*] Shooting
[*] Running
[*] Swimming
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fyDp6CG3/comp-start.gif[/img]
You have to choose the competition in which your recruits will perform best. You will be able to see the required attributes and the reward in Prestige Points. So, do you have recruits who are skilled at shooting? Then Sniper Cup. Or are you focused on agility and strength training? Then better go for a run.

In this devblog let's see the race...


[h3]Choose you man[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Gt2pVrby/comp1.gif[/img]
The first step is to choose the best recruit for the duty, so in this case, with the one with most strength and agility. Pay attention to the stamina: it is necessary to jump into the competitions with the recruits rested otherwise they will not have enough energy to complete the race. 


[h3]Run run run[/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zGVSXW5V/comp-run.gif[/img]
Watch the racer and see if your man can overtake the others...
The race is divided into multiple sessions, so if one recruit is too tired you can compete with another.


[h3]Straight to the finish line![/h3]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bwBgQgLx/comp-finish.gif[/img]
...this time It didn't go well, better get back to camp and push the trainings.

notes.title: DevBlog - Don't click on your sergeant!
notes.content:
Hello young recruits!

This is the first [b]Full Metal Sergeant[/b] devblog with the latest progress for the month.

[h3]PT Area[/h3]
The art of the PT area has been revised, enhanced with cones and tires. It will be possible to carry out workouts such as: Push-ups, Sit-ups, Jumping Jacks. Obviously with the sergeant yelling in the face ːsteamhappyː
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4YMqYyW/pt-area.gif[/img]

[h3]Multi-selection[/h3]
Implemented the multi-selection in order to send a group of recruits to a training area without to click one-by-one.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/F6vGvFc/multiselection.gif[/img]

[h3]Don't click on your sergeant![/h3]
It is possible to click and drag only the recruits, not your sergeant! Keep your hands off!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rxNM5jq/click.gif[/img]

[h3]Guardhouse[/h3]
There won't be just trainings, the [b]Guardhouse [/b]for example can be useful to make a recruit recover Stamina and Stress.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/RvQtbqx/guardhouse2.png[/img]

notes.title: This boot camp management game is inspired by Full Metal Jacket's drill sergeant
notes.content:
Full Metal Jacket is a cornerstone of military pop culture for anyone who enjoys 80s war movies, but it usually inspires something more on the nose - a first-person shooter, or if we're talking about strategy games, some kind of squad-based tactics experience. Carlo Cassini, solo designer of innovative WW2 game Until the Last Plane, is really likes the drill sergeant from the film - so much so, he made a game about it.

Full Metal Sergeant is a camp management game with auto-battle minigames. You're placed in the boots of a drill instructor at a nameless military training camp who has twelve weeks to get their recruits in shape. You'll be able to choose how your training grounds are set up, as well as manage the program itself, and you can let your recruits compete against other boot camps.

You'll have to be careful of stress levels though - ask too much, and bad things could happen. We're not sure what yet, but we've seen enough training montages to be able to take an educated guess. It usually involves a lot of shouting.
